description: Search transactions by merchant name or bank description (case-insensitive substring match), newest first. Default window is the last 30 days. Paginated with limit/offset (default 50, max 100); the response includes total_count and has_more. The response includes a `warnings` array of notices about banks that could not contribute (for example, a bank that needs reconnecting), each with a message and, when relevant, a reconnect_url.

account_id.description: Limit results to a specific account. Use an account id returned by list_accounts.

end_date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1 to 100). Defaults to 50.

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging. Defaults to 0. Use with has_more.

query.description: Text to look for in the merchant name or description, for example "netflix".

start_date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to 30 days ago.

name: search_transactions
title: Search Transactions
